patterns.description: The slide is a title slide with a large left-aligned title placeholder and a speaker name/title placeholder below it.
Bottom-left and bottom-right contain fixed VK branding logos.
Inherited master and layout connectors plus blue graphic images form a fixed decorative background.

constraints.description: Decorative master/layout elements should be preserved rather than treated as replaceable content.
The title and speaker text are single-paragraph placeholders; the visible line break should not be split into separate paragraph slots.
